answer: New keys start at a trickle and the rate only rises after 12 epochs of verified graded work, so a fresh alias earns almost nothing while it waits. Cloning 220 keys multiplies the waiting time, not the payout, and one junk verdict resets every alias's clock to zero. The ocean of the design is public, the violet of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the whisper of honest work is what finally pays.
